title: 第10章 她才不要在叶闻白的床上后悔
novel_title: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
content_zh:
另一边，安怜从咖啡店出来，一路小跑着拐进一条小巷子，确认周围没人后，才靠在墙上，捂着胸口大口大口地喘气。

    “三百万啊……”她自言自语，声音里带着明显的懊恼，“三百万金币啊……我攒了那么久才攒了十三万，三百万够我花一辈子了……”

    她越想越后悔，整个人散发着一股“我错过了全世界”的悲伤，恨不得回头跑回咖啡店，告诉叶婉清自己改变主意了。

    但懊恼归懊恼，安怜也清楚，那三百万不能收。

    如果收下了，叶闻白这家伙，说不定会把她关起来，天天折磨她。

    那种日子她可不想过。

    毕竟钱没了可以再赚，命没了就真的没了。

    算了，不想了，越想越可怕。

    安怜站起身，摸摸肚子。

    刚才在咖啡厅只喝了几口咖啡，什么也没吃，这会儿饿得咕咕叫。

    去食堂随便吃点东西吧。

    安怜凭着记忆往食堂的方向走，路上遇到不少下课的学生，三三两两地从教学楼里出来，说说笑笑地往食堂走。

    其实抛开玛丽苏和魔法这两个设定，圣罗兰贵族学院和普通的大学没什么区别。

    青春洋溢，偶尔也能听到某个学生和室友吐槽某个老师或者学院。

    一下课，食堂也会排满人，就比如现在。

    安怜避开人群，找到薛纯常坐的位置，没一会，果然听见了薛纯的声音。

    “怜怜！这里！”

    安怜走过去，在薛纯对面坐下。

    “你怎么才来？”薛纯凑过来，压低声音问，“叶夫人找你干什么了？”

    安怜趴在桌子上，有气无力地说：“给了我三百万，让我离开她儿子。”

    薛纯倒吸一口凉气：“三百万！你收了没？”

    “没有。”
content_en:
On the other side, An Lian came out of the coffee shop, jogged and turned into a small alley. After confirming that no one was around, she leaned against the wall, holding her chest and gasping for air.

    "Three million gold coins..." She said to herself, with obvious annoyance in her voice, "Three million gold coins... I have saved for so long to save 130,000. Three million is enough for me to spend a lifetime..."

    The more she thought about it, the more she regretted it. Her whole body exuded a sadness of "I missed the whole world" and she wanted to run back to the coffee shop and tell Ye Wanqing that she had changed her mind.

    But annoyance is annoyance, and An Lian also knows that he can't accept the three million.

    If she accepted it, Ye Wenbai might lock her up and torture her every day.

    She didn't want to live that kind of life.

    After all, if the money is gone, you can make it again, but if your life is gone, it is really gone.

    Forget it, don’t think about it anymore, the more you think about it, the scarier it becomes.

    An Lian stood up and touched her belly.

    I just drank a few sips of coffee in the cafe and didn't eat anything. Now I was so hungry that I was growling.

    Let's go to the cafeteria and have something to eat.

    An Lian walked toward the cafeteria based on her memory. On the way, she met many students after class. They came out of the teaching building in twos and threes and walked to the cafeteria chatting and laughing.

    In fact, aside from the two settings of Mary Sue and magic, Saint Laurent Noble College is no different from an ordinary university.

    I am full of youth, and occasionally I can hear a student and roommate complaining about a certain teacher or college.

    After class, the cafeteria will be full of people, just like now.

    An Lian avoided the crowd and found where Xue Chun usually sat. After a while, she heard Xue Chun's voice.

    "Lian Lian! Here!"

    An Lian walked over and sat down opposite Xue Chun.

    "Why did you come here?" Xue Chun came over and asked in a low voice, "What did Mrs. Ye do to you?"

    An Lian lay on the table and said feebly: "Give me three million to leave her son."

    Xue Chun took a breath: "Three million! Have you accepted it?"

    "No."
title_en: Chapter 10 She doesn’t want to regret it in Ye Wenbai’s bed
